artifacts.name: section-detail
artifacts.epitaph: The third folio sheet. Vertical cut through the letter, walls and voids hatched in aubergine ink. It served — proved that strokes have interiors. Buried with the architectural metaphor.

artifacts.name: axonometric-view
artifacts.epitaph: The fourth folio sheet. Three-dimensional projection at 30°, the crossbar of A as a floor someone could stand on. Andre LOVED Experiment 021 (the interactive version). The static view served and is buried; the experiment lives on.

artifacts.name: wall-detail
artifacts.epitaph: The fifth folio sheet. Zoomed to 1:5 — foundation course, structural core, interior void, exterior skin. Architecture's smallest scale. Buried with its larger sheets.

artifacts.name: perspective-view
artifacts.epitaph: The seventh folio sheet, A7 — the rendered perspective with vanishing points and a 5'9" scale figure. The observer's confession. The folio's last sheet, complete and exhausted. Buried tonight with the others.
